intro.text: A place where Helaran Davar left a contact so his family could reach him.
The home of the Holy Enclave, a major spanreed hub, possibly in the Valam princedom.

description.text: The Holy Enclave's store of tomes and scrolls nearly rivals the Palanaeum's. Its curates wear blue robes and carry ornate staves set with gemstones.

items.text: Shallan urged Balat to take Malise and Eylita and go to Helaran through his contact in Valath. Later, from the Shattered Plains, she paid to send a message and a spanreed to her brothers by way of Valath.
Curates from the Holy Enclave travelled to Vedenar to excommunicate Dalinar while he toured the city on behalf of the coalition of monarchs.
